newsitem.title: UK: Full steam ahead for Thomas the Tank Engine offer.
newsitem.headline: Full steam ahead for Thomas the Tank Engine offer.

text.p: International children's star Thomas the Tank Engine steamed closer to a London Stock Exchange listing, after its production company set the placing price for its shares at 130p each.

Brit Allcroft Co Plc, which produces "Thomas the Tank Engine and Friends" based on the Reverend W. Awdry's railway characters, said the placing would capitalise it at 30.6 million stg and raise 4.2 million stg net for the company.

The company said the flotation price represented an historic price-earnings multiple of 20 times, based on normalised earnings per share for the year ended June 30, 1996. In the offering, about 4.7 million shares were being sold by existing shareholders, and 3.8 million new ordinary shares were being issued by Brit Allcroft.
Dealing in the shares was expected to begin on November 6.
Price Waterhouse Corporate Finance sponsored the placing, which was underwritten by Charterhouse Tilney Securities Ltd.
